  outdir: ""

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(jsonlite)
})
```

# Run metadata

```{r}
metadata <- tibble(
  generated_at = Sys.time(),
  outdir = params$outdir
)
metadata
```

# Run artifacts

```{r, results='asis'}
run_rel <- file.path("..", "run")
links <- c("command.txt", "config_resolved.yaml", "versions.tsv", "git_rev.txt")
for (item in links) {
  cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s)\n", item, file.path(run_rel, item)))
}
```

# Samples

```{r}
if (file.exists(params$sample_table)) {
  samples <- read_tsv(params$sample_table, show_col_types = FALSE)
  samples
} else {
  cat("Sample table not found.")
}
```

# fastp summary

```{r}
fastp_files <- list.files(params$fastp_dir, pattern = "\\\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(fastp_files) > 0) {
  fastp_tbl <- lapply(fastp_files, function(path) {
    payload <- fromJSON(path)
    tibble(
      sample = gsub("\\\\.json$", "", basename(path)),
      total_reads = payload$summary$before_filtering$total_reads,
      total_bases = payload$summary$before_filtering$total_bases,
      gc_content = payload$summary$before_filtering$gc_content
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  fastp_tbl
} else {
  cat("No fastp JSON files found.")
}
```

# Salmon mapping summary

```{r}
salmon_meta <- list.files(params$salmon_dir, pattern = "meta_info\\\\.json$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
if (length(salmon_meta) > 0) {
  salmon_tbl <- lapply(salmon_meta, function(path) {
    payload <- fromJSON(path)
    tibble(
      sample = basename(dirname(path)),
      mapping_rate = payload$mapping_rate
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  salmon_tbl
} else {
  cat("No salmon meta_info.json files found.")
}
```

# tximport counts (head)

```{r}
counts_path <- file.path(params$tximport_dir, "txi.tsv")
if (file.exists(counts_path)) {
  read_tsv(counts_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% head(10)
} else {
  cat("tximport counts file not found.")
}
```

# DESeq2 results (top hits)

```{r}
results_path <- file.path(params$deseq2_dir, "results.tsv")
if (file.exists(results_path)) {
  results_tbl <- read_tsv(results_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  results_tbl %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)
} else {
  cat("DESeq2 results file not found.")
}
```

# QC plots

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
pca_path <- file.path(params$deseq2_dir, "pca.png")
if (file.exists(pca_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(pca_path)
} else {
  cat("PCA plot not found.")
}
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
heatmap_path <- file.path(params$deseq2_dir, "sample_distance_heatmap.png")
if (file.exists(heatmap_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(heatmap_path)
} else {
  cat("Sample distance heatmap not found.")

```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ma_path <- file.path(params$deseq2_dir, "ma_plot.png")
if (file.exists(ma_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(ma_path)
} else {
  cat("MA plot not found.")

```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ma_plots <- list.files(params$deseq2_dir, pattern = "^ma_plot_.*\\\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(ma_plots) > 0) {
  knitr::include_graphics(ma_plots)
}
```
